function.name: read_element
function.description: Return the full text of a package element (news, CVE field or CI). Only IDs that exist in the package.

function.name: propose_reason
function.description: Mode 1. Propose ONE adjustment reason with evidence. Code answers accepted or rejected with the broken rule. The final adjustment is the sum of accepted reasons.

points.description: Positive if up, negative if down

quote.description: Verbatim sentence from the evidence_id element

function.name: withdraw_reason
function.description: Mode 1. Withdraw a previously proposed reason.

function.name: finalize_review
function.description: Mode 1. Close the review. With no accepted reasons, the adjustment is 0. Optionally include drafted mitigation steps (D-017).

summary.description: 1–3 sentences in the configured output language (Spanish by default) for the message and the ticket

mitigation_steps.description: Drafted mitigation steps, ordered (D-017). Use ONLY facts from N1 elements of the package (NVD, CNA, KEV, vendor advisory, OSV); never from news. Every version, command or URL in action must appear verbatim in quote, and quote must appear verbatim in element_id. Code validates each step and discards the whole draft if any check fails; the data-based mitigation is always shown. Empty list if there is nothing to add.

order.description: 1-based position; temporary mitigations before the fix

ci_id.description: CI this step applies to, or empty string if it applies to all

action.description: What to do, in the configured output language (Spanish by default)

element_id.description: ID of the N1 package element that supports this step

quote.description: Verbatim sentence from element_id that supports this step

function.name: propose_alert
function.description: Mode 2. Propose an alert for a relationship the correlation engine did not detect. If the relationship is inferred, say so and propose a verification action.

ci_id.description: ID of the affected iTop CI, or empty string

cited_product.description: Product name exactly as it appears in the news, or empty string

relationship.description: Explicit relationship, e.g. 'Nginx → uses → OS OpenSSL'

function.name: dismiss_news
function.description: Mode 2. Declare that the news does not apply to the company.
